description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various language categories labeled as "family." The horizontal axis contains the categorical variables, labeled "family," which are ordered alphabetically: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "effect," using a linear scale with a visible range from approximately -5 to 35, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30) and corresponding horizontal grid lines. Within each language family category on the horizontal axis, the data is visually arranged into groups of six adjacent bars. According to the legend, these bars represent different models, distinguished by color: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). All bars are outlined in black and feature black, I-beam style error bars indicating variability. The values represented by the bars vary widely across the categories; the tallest bar is the mBERT-B₂ (light red) bar in the IE-Indic group, reaching an approximate value of 24 with an error bar extending above 30, while the lowest value is represented by the mBERT-R₂ (light green) bar in the Semitic group, which extends downward below the zero line to approximately -2.5. Categories such as Isolate and Uralic display bars with values consistently near zero across all six models. The categories are sorted alphabetically along the horizontal axis, and no individual bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard color-coding and error bar annotations.
